## About the Collaborative

The **Democracy and Political Violence Collaborative** brings together researchers who study
democracy and political violence, broadly construed — regardless of discipline, subfield, career
stage, or approach. This includes, but is not limited to, work on democratic resilience and
backsliding, support for political violence and antidemocratic policies, and the effect of
violence on political behavior.

Our goal is to provide a space for feedback, connection, and collaboration that bridges common
divides, such as subfield and discipline. We hold a mini-conference every year at MPSA and host
similar events at APSA and EPSS, along with specific workshops and meetings.
